name: e5-original-new-s1
style: English, acoustic folk pop, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, warm piano, upright bass, brushed drums, soft female vocal, 121 BPM
lyrics:
[Verse]
Blue light pooling on the sidewalk, your shadow stretched out long
You look like you've been waiting for a song that won't come on
There's a flicker in the storefront, buzzing soft and half -dead glow
And I'm three blocks from anywhere, but I'm exactly where I go

[Pre-Chorus]
Feel the bass kick through the grate, head tilted
You're already late for a moment that can't hold its shape
I'm reaching for the static on the wave

[Chorus]
Neon bleeding through the dark
A feeling with no address
You'll be a rumor by the morning
But right now, city hold us
Neon bleeding through the dark
A half smile and a spark
If this is real or just a glow
Catch it before it goes

[Outro]

lyrics:
[Verse]
Paper lanterns on the river, and the water carries slow
Every ripple holds a secret that the harbor doesn't know
There's a whistle from the ferry, drifting over mud and stone
And I'm miles away from morning, but I'm never quite alone

[Pre-Chorus]
Hear the bells across the bay
Counting down the end of day
For a feeling that won't stay the same
I'm calling out a name into the rain

[Chorus]
Lanterns floating through the dark, a promise on the tide
You'll be a story by the morning, but tonight you're by my side
Lanterns floating through the dark, a whisper and a spark
If this is real or just a dream, hold it before it goes
